27428.subject: Chemistry
27428.question_text: The presence of an impurity in substance will cause the melting point to
27428.explanation: Impurities disrupt the repeating pattern of forces that holds the solid together. So a smaller amount of energy is required to melt the part of the solid surrounding the impurity. If less energy is required, then this explains the melting point depression (lowering) observed from impure solids. The more impure the solid is, the more the structure is disrupted and the greater the variation in intermolecular forces in different areas of the solid.

31703.question_text: Use the following option above to answer this question. Which of the following compounds in solution will turn red litmus paper blue?
31703.explanation: RNH\(_2\), a general representation for an amine, turns red litmus paper blue because amines are basic in nature. When an amine is dissolved in water, it acts as a base, accepting a proton (H+) and forming a conjugate acid and a hydroxide ion (OH-). The presence of hydroxide ions makes the solution alkaline, and alkaline solutions turn red litmus paper blue.
